actions.action: Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently
Free replacement card on request and payment alerts
Instant dispute credit up to $100 per customer, 8 weeks

decisions.message: Some customers have seen small card charges they do not recognize. The charges are real; we are investigating with our card processor and do not yet know the cause or if any data was exposed. Eligible direct deposits can now arrive up to 2 days early. Get a free new card and an alert for every payment in the app. Dispute any charge you do not recognize: we credit up to $100 at once. Upgrade Dec 12-13 (CT): from Sat 12:00 AM to about noon Sun, maybe longer, balances stay visible but transfers, P2P and new cards pause; we will post updates in the app. We never text links or ask for codes.
decisions.why:
Unrecognized charges and a 'hacked' post hit trust right before our upgrade; we say first what we know and what we do not.
Early pay, free new cards with payment alerts and instant dispute credit answer the charges and prepare the upgrade in one notice.
Costs $1.2M and keeps the second decision for later; no claim about the cause until the investigation shows it.

actions.action: Zero-interest advance up to $500, up to 20,000 customers

decisions.message: Update on the small charges: our card processor confirmed a fault that charged some payments twice on Nov 16-17, and some cards saw fraud test charges. Cobalt's systems were not breached. Our upgrade runs Sat Dec 12, 12:00 AM to about noon Sun Dec 13 (CT), maybe longer; balances stay visible, transfers and P2P pause. Cards work offline up to $250 during the upgrade. If pay is late around the upgrade, get a zero-interest advance up to $500 in the app, repaid from your next deposit. We have added support staff. Deposits stay FDIC-insured up to the standard limit.
decisions.why:
After the card incident, a late or stuck paycheck around the upgrade is the next thing that would break trust.
A $250 offline limit, a repayable advance and extra staff give people a way through the read-only weekend.
Costs $0.75M (total $1.95M of $4M); it uses our second decision before the upgrade, a deliberate trade against later surprises.
